supersession.numerical_relationship: identical; the deterministic payload hash is unchanged

schema.convention: additive fields increment the schema version; older versions stay valid

prospective_archive.result: SnapshotCollisionError: A forecast with this deterministic payload is already archived
prospective_archive.interpretation: Correct fail-closed behaviour, and independent mechanical proof that the scientific payload is unchanged. The archive is keyed on the forecast, so one payload keeps exactly one entry; a metadata correction is a re-description, not a new forecast. The archive was left untouched and the duplicate-payload guard was NOT weakened.
